description: A photograph depicting a natural or semi-natural coniferous forest. The image shows a dense stand of tall, evergreen coniferous trees, primarily covering the upper and right portions of a sloped terrain. The ground in the foreground and between some trees is rocky, with numerous light-coloured rocks interspersed with green grass and small shrubs. The overall scene suggests a mixed habitat of coniferous vegetation and a rocky, herbaceous understorey, consistent with the document's definition of "Natural and semi-natural coniferous forest" where coniferous species predominate.
